verdict.rationale: Cubic can help narrow down root causes via chat with diff/codebase context, PR 'tour', and codebase scans that flag bugs, and it can verify fixes by re-reviewing after a push/force-push and offering 'Fix with cubic' to generate and push a fix. However there is no evidence it can actually reproduce issues (e.g., run/execute code, tests, or a live debugging session) — its role is static AI review/chat, not execution-based reproduction. Missing for 10: issue reproduction/execution capability, test-running or sandboxed debugging, independent evidence of root-cause accuracy beyond vendor docs.
